name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. The FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the sandbox. I first tested with curl (as shown in the quickstart docs), then installed the OpenAI Python SDK and ran the Python example. A chat completion was successfully returned from a Fireworks-hosted model: the assistant responded "Hola." to the prompt "Say hello in Spanish".
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a `NOT_FOUND` error from the API. I had to substitute `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash` (confirmed available via the models endpoint) to get a successful chat completion. All other steps followed the docs exactly.
